purpose: Distinguish geometry/model effects, numerical resolution, and policy feedback using the completed successful v9 actor.

fixed.geometry: same authored 50 mm finite cylinder, original mass and inertia
fixed.initial_state: exact archived nominal state including wheel spin and all joint velocities
fixed.task_gates: unchanged; evaluate events in seconds and at native physical rate

required_preflight: Reproduce the archived baseline before interpreting any changed configuration.
Read back installed engine version, solver type, effective position/velocity iteration counts, stabilization, material and contact offsets.
Keep these values fixed for the timestep sweep; do not infer them from this paper's historical engine labels.
Run serial single-environment jobs on an available authorized GPU without changing other workloads.
control_conditions: Short action-replay probes from identical archived states with identical normalized action/actuator targets; low-level PD still depends on the resulting state.
Full 2.76 s closed-loop frozen-policy rollout; report feedback response separately from action-replay probes.
record: All body poses, COM twists and applied joint torques at each physical step
Native normal points, normals, separations and impulses
Patch identities, patch normal impulse and solver-stage tangential velocities if exposed; otherwise retain unavailable status
compare: Sampled bilateral contact and penetration/separation distributions
Material slip and friction opposition with threshold sensitivity
Net momentum residual and force timing negative controls
XY tracking, stopping, body angular acceleration and original task gates
Differences as physical step/iteration count changes, without treating the smallest step as measured reality
